findings.title: Failed stats request is shown as 'No harvests in this range'
findings.expected: A visible error with a way to retry when the stats request fails
findings.actual: With the request returning 500, the page shows the empty state 'No harvests in this range' and no error
findings.evidence: {"hits":2,"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"hits":2,"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: From date after To date (via URL) shows empty state instead of the server's reason
findings.expected: The 422 message 'The From date must be on or before the To date.' or a similar error is shown
findings.actual: Page shows 'No harvests in this range', implying the range was valid and empty
findings.evidence: {"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"alerts":[],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","No harvests in this range","Pick a different date range, or log a harvest to see it here.","Log harvest","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: Malformed stats response crashes the page and leaves it stuck on 'Loading stats…'
findings.expected: An error message and no uncaught exception
findings.actual: Uncaught TypeError "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"; the page keeps showing 'Loading stats…' above the old range's data
findings.evidence: {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"]} | {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"text":["Stats","Harvest weight per plant and month.","Log harvest","From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette","1.2 kg","View","Courgette","NO. 2","Tomato"]}

findings.title: Clearing the To date silently extends the range to the end of the current year
findings.expected: An empty To field is refused or treated in a way that makes sense for the chosen range
findings.actual: From 2025-01-01 with To cleared shows '6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026' while the To field stays blank
findings.evidence: {"line":"6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026","fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2025-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":""}]} | {"line":"6 harvests from 1 Jan 2025 to 31 Dec 2026","fields":[{"label":"From","value":"2025-01-01"},{"label":"To","value":""}]}

findings.title: Hung stats request leaves 'Loading stats…' forever with the old range's data shown
findings.expected: A timeout or error after a reasonable wait, and stale results not shown as if they were current
findings.actual: After 13 s the page still shows 'Loading stats…' above the previous range's table (1 Jan to 31 Dec 2026) while From reads 2026-05-01
findings.evidence: {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette"]} | {"text":["From","To","This year","Loading stats…","Best plants","NO. 1","Courgette"]}
